meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 修复或配置OneCLI：检查是否已安装，未装则安装；迁移.env里的Anthropic等密钥到OneCLI Agent Vault并删除明文；构建并重启NanoClaw服务；验证OneCLI网关配置。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 更新引入 OneCLI 后（破坏性变更），或首次设置 OneCLI 时触发。也可用于从 .env 凭据代理切换到 OneCLI Agent Vault。

say.text: 帮我初始化OneCLI并迁移.env里的凭据

say.note: 技能会检查环境并执行安装、迁移、重启。
技能会将其迁入vault并从.env移除。

howto.what_en: Installs or fixes OneCLI: checks if installed, migrates .env credentials like Anthropic keys into the OneCLI Agent Vault and strips them from .env, then builds and restarts the NanoClaw service and verifies the gateway configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or when setting up OneCLI for the first time. Also used when switching from the .env credential proxy to the Agent Vault.

say_en.text: Help me initialize OneCLI and migrate .env credentials.
say_en.note: Installs OneCLI and moves Anthropic keys into the vault.

say_en.text: I updated nanoclaw and need OneCLI configured.
say_en.note: Checks the environment, installs, migrates, and restarts.
Moves it into the vault and removes it from .env.
